entities.summary: Darius Demetrius Slay Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback for 13 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Itawamba Indians before transferring to the Mississippi State Bulldogs. He was selected by the Detroit Lions in the second round of the 2013 NFL draft. Nicknamed "Big Play Slay", Slay won Super Bowl LIX with the Philadelphia Eagles in the 2024 season. He also played one season for the Pittsburgh Steelers.
